by
  change RCLike.re (Matrix.trace (Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ (f i : 𝕜)))) = _
  rw [Matrix.trace_diagonal]; simp
explanation: Instantiate Matrix.trace_diagonal with the real-valued entries cast into 𝕜. Unfolding the Hermitian wrappers and simplifying the real part gives the result. The current proof instead unfolds Matrix.trace.
